Reference / runtime/postgres

runtime/postgres#

The native layer under db/postgres: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under db/postgres: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

The DataRow messages of one result portion (raw, as read from the wire) become one result page in the PostgreSQL text format: one call per portion instead of one object per row and column. types are the column type oids.

Cells use the db cell codes (0 null, 1 boolean, 2 integer, 3 floating, 4 decimal, 5 text, 6 bytes); a value is the integer of an integer or boolean cell, else the ordinal of the cell in its typed array (decimals and texts share pg_page_texts). A malformed portion gives a page whose failure is one of "message", "truncated", "width", "utf8", "integer", "floating", "nonfinite", "bytea"; a whole page has an empty failure.
